newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: S.Lanka to sell stake in state mortgage bank - paper.
newsitem.headline: S.Lanka to sell stake in state mortgage bank - paper.

text.p: Sri Lanka plans to sell a 40 percent stake and management of the State Mortgage and Investment Bank (SMIB) to a strategic investor, the state-run Daily News on Saturday quoted the deputy finance minister as saying.
The newspaper quoted Gamini Peiris as saying the government wanted to sell a strategic stake in the bank so that the new management could expand its activities and improve customer service.
Five percent of the shares of the government-funded bank will be given to its 264 employees, he said.
Peiris said one local private bank and a finance company -- Commercial Bank and Vanik Incorporation Ltd -- had expressed interest in buying the SMIB stake.
